label: GPT-6 Astra (minimal loop)
explanation: Unedited tests showed pervasive self-questioning and equation loops: all 16 initial math replies exhausted 8192 tokens without completing thinking, and independent simple math tests reproduced the failure. Two independent activation contrasts identified a productive-versus-repetitive direction. The adapter uses three rank-one updates: loop-selective corrections in layers 21 and 22 linear-attention outputs, with input keys projected away from productive and ordinary-start prototypes, plus a modest amplification of layer 19 MLP's existing productive-reasoning component. Natural arithmetic and symbolic loop probes supported the diagnosis. Update Frobenius norms are 2.01%, 3.92%, and 1.81% of the respective weights. No gradients, optimization, network reimplementation, or edited-model evaluation were used; held-out improvement remains unverified.
